entry.title: 40 Wall Street
entry.note: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms unchanged exact Q218305 whole outline 278042253 and twenty-nine separately retained mapped parts, including roof 286057109. Signed heading -0.668872591958 retained: native +X southeast, +Z southwest. Wall Street facade is +Z south/southwest; the longer Pine Street pavilion is -Z north/northeast. Shaft remains east of plot center. Roof rectangle supplies its signed copper-pyramid frame. Ground Y=0 is bank street datum. LPC Pine/Wall elevations and cadastral plan support these asymmetric sides. Mapped part heights are estimates rather than surveyed storey sections. Accept 2 m footprint / 1 degree reconstruction allowance; automatic footprint replacement disabled. Local slope and door thresholds are unmeasured. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
